instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym ring with hanging punching bags, the woman in the black and orange athletic suit (R1) stands on the left facing right, holding up a red focus mitt to block an incoming strike. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right facing left, her back partially to the camera, extending her left arm to land a punch with her black glove directly on the mitt. Cool overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting their athletic poses and casting soft shadows across the ring.
